title: baldie free-tier registry
description: Curated, person-maintained registry of free / free-tier / self-hostable services that baldie consults before recommending anything. Refreshed weekly by scripts/refresh-free-tier.js (see data/changelog.md). Fields that end in _verified are only restamped when the service is re-seen upstream; anything left null has not been verified on this mechanism.
